description.value: Y-5 Motel & Campground Ltd has been serving travellers in Barriere, BC since 1998, offering 22 motel units (1- or 2-bedroom, some with kitchenettes) alongside pull-through campground facilities. Situated on the Southern Yellowhead Highway in south-central BC, it sits amid forest-covered mountains with access to hiking, fishing, kayaking, and rafting, and is a short drive from Sun Peaks Resort and Wells Gray Park. The property welcomes work crews, tourists, and extended-stay guests, with a restaurant immediately next door.

address.value: 4325 Southern Yellowhead Hwy, Barriere, BC V0E 1E0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully operational and confirms the business at 4325 Southern Yellowhead Hwy, Barriere, BC. Contact details (phone, address, email) match OSM exactly. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or most cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; free Wi-Fi and a next-door restaurant are explicitly confirmed.
concerns: OSM name is 'Y5 Motel & Campground' (no hyphen, no 'Ltd') while the website consistently uses 'Y-5 Motel & Campground Ltd' — minor branding discrepancy, not substantive.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel and campground on the Southern Yellowhead Highway with an active website, confirmed contact details, and relevant amenities for touring cyclists passing through Barriere.
